simple.meaning: הַוָּה (havvâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “by implication, of falling) ; desire ; also ruin.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 16 times across Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Micah, beginning at Job 6:2. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.

definitions.short: by implication, of falling) ; desire ; also ruin
definitions.usage: calamity, iniquity, mischief, mischievous (thing), naughtiness, naughty, noisome, perverse thing, substance, very wickedness.
definitions.full: H1942. havvah הַוָּה noun feminine 1. desire ; 2 chasm , figurative destruction (compare desire , atmosphere, emptiness , a deep pit, hell (compare below הָוָה ); Aramaic gulf, chasm ( Luke 16:26 ᵑ6 )) construct הַוַּת Micah 7:3 +, suffix הַוָּתִי Job 6:2 +, plural הַוּוֺת Psa 5:10 +; — 1 desire (in bad sense) Micah 7:3 נַפְשׁוֺ הַוַּת דֹּבֵר speaketh the desire of his soul, Prov 10:3 רְשָׁעִים הַוַּת , 11:6 ׳ה בֹּגְדִים , Psa 52:9 בְּהַוָּתוֺ יָעֹז became strong through his (evil) desire (but read rather with ᵑ7 ᵑ6 Lag Gr Bi Che Now בְּהוֺנוֺ ׃ || בְּעָשְׁרוֺ ). 2 engulfing ruin, destruction Job 6:2 ; Qr 30:13 (compare Baer's note) הַוָּתִי of Job's great calamity; plural (intensive) הַוּוֺת , especially as wrought, or meditated, by one against another, Psa 5:10 הַוּוֺת קִרְבָּם their inward part is engulfing ruin (Che), 38:13 הַוּוֺת דִּבְּרוּ , 52:4 לְשׁוֺנְךָ ׳ה תַּחֲשֹׁב (compare Prov 17:4 הַוּוֺת לְשׁוֺן ), Prov 55:12 ׳ה בְּקִרְבָּהּ , Prov 57:2 ה יַעֲבֹר ׳עַד till the storm of ruin (Che) pass by, Prov 91:3 ה ׳דֶּבֶר destructive pestilence, Prov 94:20 ה ׳כִּסֵּא the seat (tribunal) of destruction (i.e. which ruins the innocent by injustice), 19:13 a foolish son is לְאָבָיו הַוּוֺת , Job 6:30 (compare 6:2 above)

occurrences.englishText: Is there injustice on my tongue?
But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear.
I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it.
For it was not an enemy who insulted me,
I cry out to God Most High,
For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler,
Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you,
Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry,
The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them,
A foolish son is the calamity of his father.
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently.
